column1: # The music catalogue: the game's song numbers and their names (docs/music-player.md section 4).
# Song N is the PC's BGM\NNN.DAT and the PSX song table's entry N. The build copies this file
# beside the launcher, whose Jukebox shows box_title where it is set, else name.
# name       provisional, from `source`: game = the faerie village's music menu (US disc);
#            ossb = breath of fire original soutrack special box (disc 5-7)
#            kk = kero's name from listening, mostly sound effects
#            psf = the zophar PSF rip's title (unsourced); same-notes = hidden from the Jukebox:
#            too like another song, or the same one (a titled song's events under another bank).
# box_disc, box_track, box_title   the collector's box soundtrack discs (the owner's catalogue).
# note       measurements and clashes; they describe the data only. Every row is independent:
#            marking one same-notes hides that song alone.
